title: Meridian Contact Centre Current-State Supplemental Intake V2
pii_phi_handling: Synthetic, PHI-free, planning-grade contact-centre operating evidence. No member, patient, provider, claim-line, transcript, PHI, PII or production records are included. The package explicitly excludes transcripts, which are PHI-bearing, and states so in its own gap-coverage tab. Every KPI and cost figure is a synthetic planning figure and must never be presented as measured, Finance-confirmed, or realized value.
notes: Supplemental current-state intake for the Contact Center Platform / Knowledge Modernization Move (PROG-CONTACT-KNOW), landed alongside the canonical packet rather than inside it so the pre-upload run stays intact as the control. ingestion_method records the approved production path (admin bulk loader); the present load is a local read-only proof harness over the same files, which writes nothing to the data plane. That harness runs the P2 evidence-traceability smoke, measuring whether each uploaded fact reaches the rendered artifact's gap analysis. The package carries its own claim prohibitions (tab 10), including that the capability is already production_enterprise_wide and must not be presented as an opportunity case; those merge into the tenant's prohibition set. Its gap-coverage tab (02) declares which Home-identified gaps it PARTIALLY fills and which remain deliberately open, and that declaration is the smoke's expected result.
